exact_continuation: Turn the two Mission View persistence variants into literal Argus tests: (A) pre-replace projection loss must be repaired from canonical E1 before fresh-sink E2; (B) real replace followed by EIO must be resolved by readback so E1 is not double-applied. Implement the exact schema-7 migration table with embedded event_log_id cursor and legacy-null-cursor one-extra-rebuild semantics. Factor a lock-order-safe event_log_locked helper for events.lock -> mission-view.lock stable all-generation replay. Extend the recent-first byte cursor locator benchmark to deeper generations/boundary positions while keeping full JSON replay authoritative. Separately design candidate-008 fault injection for event-file fsync, rollover-directory fsync, Mission View post-replace ambiguity, and log-durable-before-view ordering. Re-read Argus main next invocation and keep optional Manager transition_id provenance separate.

run_findings.candidate_007_status: strengthened with explicit pre-replace versus post-replace-ambiguous failure semantics, an exact schema-7 migration contract, and a measured recent-first opaque-cursor locator optimization
run_findings.candidate_007_variant_a: pre-replace Mission View loss leaves canonical E1 durable but view behind; fresh-sink E2 must reconcile E1 then E2 and end rejected_attempts=2
run_findings.candidate_007_variant_b: Mission View replace can land before an EIO is observed; recovery must read back state/cursor before replay or E1 can be double-applied, yielding rejected_attempts=3 instead of 2
run_findings.candidate_007_internal_precedent: Argus continuous.json already implements file fsync + replace + directory fsync + post-replace ambiguity detection and has a replace-then-fail regression test
run_findings.candidate_007_schema7: schema<=6 forces one all-generation rebuild; schema7 stores projection.event_log_id in the same mission-view.json replacement; legacy-only rebuild may persist null cursor and the first later sink-owned projected event performs one additional full rebuild to establish the anchor
run_findings.candidate_007_identity: normalize_event_envelope preserves unknown envelope fields and frontend EventMsg is open; use a distinct sink-owned event_log_id that overwrites caller input and is minted once in a shared persisted-event preparation path

run_findings.candidate_007_lock_order: writer order is events.lock -> mission-view.lock while current snapshot bootstraps under mission-view.lock; use a double-check that releases mission lock before acquiring events.lock -> mission-view.lock
